Those numbers matter when you shop at a dispensary, receive cannabis delivery, travel within the state, or simply want to understand how New York’s adult-use law works.

The legal possession limit in New York

Adults 21+ may possess up to 3 ounces of cannabis and 24 grams of concentrated cannabis. OCM guidance uses the concentrate limit when discussing products such as oils and, in delivery guidance, categories including tinctures, edibles, and vapes.

Is the purchase limit the same as the possession limit?

In practical retail terms, licensed dispensaries must keep sales within New York’s legal limits. OCM’s delivery guidance specifically states that adults 21+ can purchase up to 3 ounces of cannabis flower and up to 24 grams of concentrated cannabis in a single day for delivery. A retailer may also set lower limits based on inventory or operational policies.

How much cannabis can you keep at home?

New York allows adults 21+ to possess up to 5 pounds of cannabis in a private residence or on its grounds. Cannabis in the home must be stored securely and kept away from children and anyone under 21.

What about home-grown cannabis?

Adults 21+ may grow up to three mature and three immature plants for personal use, with a household maximum of six mature and six immature plants. Home cultivation has additional requirements, including taking reasonable steps to secure plants and prevent access by people under 21.

Can two adults each carry 3 ounces?

The state’s personal-possession rule applies to adults individually, but the facts of any situation can matter, and other rules may apply depending on how cannabis is packaged, transported, transferred, or stored. Do not use the possession limit as a workaround for unlicensed resale or distribution.

Can you have cannabis in your car?

Adults must remain within legal possession limits, and cannabis cannot be consumed in a vehicle. OCM also states that open cannabis packages are not permitted in vehicles in a manner comparable to open-container rules. Never drive while impaired.

Does the limit mean you should buy that much?

Not necessarily. Legal maximums are limits, not shopping recommendations. For most shoppers, product freshness, storage, frequency of use, and personal preference are more useful ways to decide how much to purchase.

If you are newer to cannabis, buying a smaller amount gives you room to learn what formats, flavors, potencies, and product styles you actually enjoy before stocking up.

The easiest numbers to remember

21+ to purchase and possess. Up to 3 ounces of cannabis. Up to 24 grams of concentrated cannabis. Up to 5 pounds stored securely at a private residence. And no cannabis across state or international borders.
